subject: PulseHealth discovery follow-up — confirm eval kickoff & prework
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Riley Zhang <riley@pulsehealth.ai>, Lindsay Cho <lindsay@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-03T18:20:00Z
Subject: PulseHealth discovery follow-up — eval kickoff windows and prework

Hi Riley / Lindsay,

Appreciate the time today — useful discussion. Below is a short recap plus concrete proposals to get the evaluation kickoff scheduled (technical deep dive + trial ops). Goal is to have an agreed kickoff within the next two weeks so engineering can reserve a 90-minute block.

Quick recap of priorities:
- Use case: automatic clinical note summarization and priority triage for ED referrals.
- Key outcomes: reduce triage queue time to <4 hours for priority flags, maintain summary fidelity vs. clinical extract targets, and zero PHI exfiltration in logs.
- Security: you emphasized SOC2 evidence, a VPC-based test environment, and strict retention controls.

Suggested kickoff (90 min):
- 10 min: introductions & goals / success criteria alignment
- 40 min: prompts and eval design (Marissa leading; bring your prompt examples)
- 30 min: infra & deployment options (on-prem/private variants, network peering checklist)
- 10 min: trial timeline, roles, next steps (Ben leads)

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Mon Oct 9 11:00:00
- Wed Oct 11 14:00:30
- Thu Oct 12 08:00:30

Pre-kickoff asks (short):
1) Please upload 3 sample prompts you want prioritized (or paste them in the pre-kickoff form).
2) Share the infra contact for VPC/network peering (name & email).
3) Any non-negotiable compliance constraints (retention, redaction) we should bake into the trial charter.

I attached a short trial charter and our 1-page eval playbook to help with prep. If you confirm a window Ill send a calendar invite and a 3-question pre-kickoff form we ask customers to complete.

Thanks —
Priyom
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: pulse-trial-charter-v0.2.pdf, redwood-eval-playbook-brief.pdf

From: Riley Zhang <riley@pulsehealth.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lindsay Cho <lindsay@healthgrid.com>
Date: 2028-10-04T16:14:00Z
Subject: Re: PulseHealth discovery follow-up — eval kickoff windows and prework

Thanks Priyom  the summary looks good. Wed Oct 11 14:00 PDT works best for our clinical informatics and infra leads. Please prioritize prompts/eval design in the agenda  we can.

Couple of items before the kickoff:
- Can you share SOC2 summary or attestation and the security lead who can answer network peering questions? Our infra team needs that before we provide test access.
- We like to see an architecture sketch for the private/on-prem option (latency and cost ranges are fine).
- Ill upload three prompt examples to the pre-kickoff form once you send it.

Will accept the invite once it lands.

Riley Zhang
Director, Data & Clinical Systems | PulseHealth
riley@pulsehealth.ai | +1 415-666-1024

Riley  thanks  Wed Oct 11 14:00 PDT is locked on our side. Calendar invite sent (https://calendar.redwood.ai/slots/PH-0421)  please accept when you get it.

Quick responses to your asks:
- SOC2 & security contact: attaching a SOC2 summary to the trial charter in the shared drive and looping Marissa as our security/SE lead for the kickoff. She can cover VPC peering requirements and what we need to provision test access.
- Private/on-prem sketch: well include a short slide with an architecture diagram and expected latency/cost bands for the three common configs (hosted, dedicated, private).
- Agenda focus: confirmed  Marissa will lead prompts/eval design with examples you upload to the pre-kickoff form (link below).

Pre-kickoff form: https://redwood.documents/s/PH-prekick-qs (3 quick fields).
Shared docs: https://redwood.documents/s/PH-trial-charter (charter + SOC2 summary).

See you on Oct 11. If infra asks for anything sooner, reply-all and well triage.

Best,
Priyom
